svg.title: An untidy spreadsheet with six common problems numbered
svg.desc: A small spreadsheet of a time use pilot. Numbered markers point to six problems: 1, a merged title cell across the top; 2, a note typed into a data cell; 3, a row highlighted yellow to mean re-check; 4, two values in one cell; 5, units typed inside a value; 6, a second table below the first on the same sheet.
svg.text: Note typed into a data cell
More than one value in a cell
